x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

Nevenfunctie.title: Nevenfunctie
Nevenfunctie.description: A structured other-position declaration (nevenfunctie) held by a Person at an organisation, made under a specific GovernanceBody's disclosure regime: bezoldigd/onbezoldigd, hours indication, a q.q. flag (uit hoofde van het ambt), start/end dates, a declared-at and reviewed-at date, a declarative disclosure lifecycle (gemeld → openbaar | intern → beëindigd), and a live public nevenfunctiesregister per body via the OpenRegister published-predicate. A nevenfunctie is a schema:Role. It supersedes Membership.otherPositions for new data (the free-text legacy field is not removed). CONSTRAINT (design D4): this schema contains ONLY publishable fields by construction. NO remuneration amounts, NO private contact data, NO free-form internal-remarks property. Adding ANY non-public property requires revisiting the public-predicate design in D4, because the whole live object is exposed through the public-group authorization.read rule when publicationDate <= $now.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded disclosure workflow (ADR-031, REQ-INT-002). Canonical dialect verbatim (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'default'). gemeld → openbaar | intern (griffie/staff verification sets the disclosure state; the per-body Integriteitsbeleid.nevenfunctieDisclosureDefault only PRESELECTS the target, never bypasses the explicit transition — REQ-INT-003); openbaar ↔ intern rectification; openbaar/intern → beëindigd (ending records endDate). beëindigd is terminal. No app-side state machine.

nevenfunctieGemeld._note: Integrity notification on a new declaration (REQ-INT-009). Recipient SHOULD be the body's configured integrity group (Integriteitsbeleid.integriteitsNotificatieGroep — burgemeester/voorzitter/compliance). The notification dialect cannot read a recipient group from a RELATED policy object, so per design D3 / Risk 3 this uses one literal integrity group ('decidesk-integriteit') with per-body routing handled by group membership (documented, never silent); verify against OR during apply whether a policy-object lookup is supported.

nevenfunctieGewijzigd._note: Integrity notification on a changed declaration (REQ-INT-009 updated trigger). Same literal-group fallback as nevenfunctieGemeld.

nevenfunctieJaarlijkseReview._note: Annual review rappel (REQ-INT-008). intervalSec 2592000 (~30 days evaluation cadence) is the trigger's re-evaluation period, NOT the review window. The 'reviewedAt (or declaredAt when never reviewed) more than 12 months in the past' condition is a relative-date filter the simple filter shape cannot express — this filter targets only non-terminal lifecycle (beëindigd excluded); verify OR's scheduled-notification engine supports the 12-month relative-date cutoff during live import (design Open Questions; fallback: index quick-filter carries the cutoff, documented not silent). Recipient approximates the object's Person via object-acl (read), because no recipient kind targets the person reference field directly. The member confirms via self-service (REQ-INT-010), writing reviewedAt (saveObject PUT-semantic).

person.title: Person
person.description: Reference to the Person who holds the nevenfunctie (schema:Role holder). Required.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody under whose disclosure regime the declaration is made (its Integriteitsbeleid sets the disclosure default and integrity recipient). Required: a person holding roles in two bodies faces two regimes and declares once per body (design D5).

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: Name of the organisation where the position is held. Required. A plain string (not a UID field) so the object stays fully publishable (design D4).

role.title: Function
role.description: Description of the function / role held (e.g. bestuurslid, docent). Required.

remunerated.title: Remunerated
remunerated.description: Whether the position is bezoldigd (paid) or onbezoldigd. Required. The schema deliberately carries NO remuneration AMOUNT (design D4 publishability constraint); only the paid/unpaid fact.

hoursIndication.title: Hours indication
hoursIndication.description: Free-text indication of the time commitment (e.g. '4 uur/week'). Optional.

qualitateQua.title: Ex officio (q.q.)
qualitateQua.description: Whether the position is held uit hoofde van het ambt (qualitate qua) rather than personally: a q.q. marker distinguishes it in the register.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Date the position ended. Set when the lifecycle moves to beëindigd. Optional.

declaredAt.title: Declared at
declaredAt.description: Date the nevenfunctie was declared. Required. Drives the annual-review rappel when reviewedAt is never set.

reviewedAt.title: Reviewed at
reviewedAt.description: Date of the last annual self-review confirmation. Set by the member via self-service, carrying all other fields forward (saveObject PUT-semantic). Optional; when older than 12 months (or absent) the object counts toward the overdue-review KPI and the annual rappel.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Disclosure status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): gemeld → openbaar | intern → beëindigd. beëindigd is terminal. Legislative bodies default the target to openbaar (Gemeentewet), other body types to intern (design).

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past on a verified openbaar nevenfunctie, the LIVE object is anonymously readable through the OpenRegister published-predicate (public-group authorization.read rule publicationDate <= $now). Publish is an explicit staff action (griffie); because the predicate sits on the live object the public register reflects lifecycle changes (e.g. beëindigd with endDate) without republication (design D4).

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, the nevenfunctie is withdrawn from public access. Set by staff on withdraw.

Geschenk.title: Geschenk
Geschenk.description: A registered gift or invitation (geschenk/uitnodiging) received by a Person acting for a GovernanceBody: the giving party as a plain string (never a Person reference, so no external-party PII enters the people register), a description, an estimated value in EUR, the date received, and a decision (aanvaard/geweigerd/overgedragen). Evaluated against the body's Integriteitsbeleid.geschenkDrempelbedrag (or EUR 50 default): at-or-above-threshold registrations are badged boven-drempel and trigger the integrity notification. A geschenk-registratie is a schema:Action (agent = recipient). Optionally published per body policy (geschenkenOpenbaar) via the same public-predicate as Nevenfunctie. CONSTRAINT (design D4): publishable by construction. NO internal-remarks beyond the toelichting decision note; adding any non-public property requires revisiting the public-predicate design.

geschenkBovenDrempel._note: Integrity notification on a boven-drempel gift registration (REQ-INT-009, scoped by REQ-INT-006). The 'geschatteWaarde at or above the body's geschenkDrempelbedrag (policy or EUR 50)' condition is a per-body threshold comparison the simple created-trigger filter cannot express (the threshold lives on a related Integriteitsbeleid object) — per design D3 / Risk 3 this fires on every created Geschenk to the literal integrity group ('decidesk-integriteit'); the boven-drempel badge (frontend render rule) is the authoritative visual scoping and the below-threshold-stays-quiet guarantee is enforced there. Verify against OR during apply whether a threshold-from-policy filter is expressible; fallback documented, never silent.

recipient.title: Recipient
recipient.description: Reference to the Person who received the gift/invitation (schema:Action agent). Required.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody whose Integriteitsbeleid governs the threshold, notification recipient, and public-register opt-in. Required.

type.title: Type
type.description: Whether the registration is a geschenk (gift) or an uitnodiging (invitation). Required.

giver.title: Giver
giver.description: The giving party as a plain display string. NEVER a Person reference, so no external-party PII enters the people register (design D4 / security). Required.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the gift or invitation. Required.

estimatedValue.title: Estimated value (EUR)
estimatedValue.description: Estimated value in EUR. Required. Compared against the body's geschenkDrempelbedrag (policy or EUR 50 default): at-or-above-threshold drives the boven-drempel badge and integrity notification. No remuneration/monetary sub-object: a plain number so the object stays publishable (design D4).

receivedOn.title: Received on
receivedOn.description: Date the gift/invitation was received. Required.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Decision on the gift/invitation. Required. The threshold is registration policy only: the system does NOT block saving any decision value.

notes.title: Note
notes.description: Optional note explaining the decision (e.g. why an invitation was refused or handed over).

declaredAt.title: Declared at
declaredAt.description: Date the gift/invitation was registered. Required.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When the body's Integriteitsbeleid sets geschenkenOpenbaar true and staff publish, the LIVE geschenk is anonymously readable through the OpenRegister published-predicate (public-group authorization.read rule publicationDate <= $now). Publication is an explicit staff action and off by default per body policy.

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, the geschenk is withdrawn from public access. Set by staff on withdraw.

Integriteitsbeleid.title: Integriteitsbeleid
Integriteitsbeleid.description: Per-body integrity policy (one object per GovernanceBody) driving the interests-and-integrity defaults: the nevenfunctie disclosure default (openbaar/intern), the gift threshold in EUR, whether the geschenkenregister is public for this body, and the NC group receiving integrity notifications (burgemeester/voorzitter/compliance officer as configured). A schema (not GovernanceBody fields) because ADR-037 forbids editing the base register where GovernanceBody lives (design D1). When no policy object exists for a body, body-type defaults apply: legislative/democratic bodies default to openbaar (Gemeentewet), all other body types to intern, and the gift threshold to EUR 50 (model-gedragscode),. This is internal configuration: it carries NO public read rule.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody this policy governs (one Integriteitsbeleid object per body). Required.

ancillaryPositionDisclosureDefault.title: Nevenfunctie disclosure default
ancillaryPositionDisclosureDefault.description: The disclosure target PRESELECTED when a gemeld nevenfunctie is processed for this body (openbaar for councils per Gemeentewet, intern for corporate boards). It preselects only: it does NOT bypass the explicit x-openregister-lifecycle transition. Required.

giftThresholdAmount.title: Gift threshold (EUR)
giftThresholdAmount.description: Gift threshold in EUR: geschenken with geschatteWaarde at or above this value are badged boven-drempel and trigger the integrity notification. Defaults to EUR 50 (model-gedragscode) when no policy object exists for the body.

giftsPublic.title: Public gift register
giftsPublic.description: Whether this body's geschenkenregister is public: when true, published geschenken are anonymously readable via the same public-predicate as nevenfuncties; when false (default) no publish action is offered and no geschenk of this body is anonymously readable.

integrityNotificationGroup.title: Integrity notification group
integrityNotificationGroup.description: The NC group receiving this body's integrity notifications (mapped to burgemeester, voorzitter, or compliance officer as configured per body). Optional. Note (design D3 / Risk 3): the x-openregister-notifications dialect cannot currently read this per-body value from the related policy object, so the notification triggers use one literal integrity group with per-body routing via group membership until a policy-object lookup is verified against OR.
